name: Elisabella wa Tsukaima o Yobu.
original_name: エリザベッラは使い魔を喚ぶ。
source:
The vampire Elisabella has escaped from the cat she had captured! She was going to use it as a demon and show it off to her brethren at the banquet. She was going to show it off to her compatriots at the banquet...! But she has no choice, so she decides to use the box of the wise men, She decides to summon a demon using the wise man's box, but...?

[Translated From [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/2981216]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
吸血鬼伊丽莎白从她捕获的猫手中逃脱了！她要把它当作恶魔，在宴会上向弟兄们炫耀。她要在宴会上向同胞们炫耀……！但她别无选择，所以她决定使用智者的盒子，她决定使用智者的盒子召唤恶魔，但是……？

[译自[url=https://booth.pm/en/items/2981216]BOOTH[/url]]
